headline: Chamarajanagar shows improved malnutrition identification, yet officials lag in reaching children with nutritious food and welfare programs
summary: Chamarajanagar district struggled with identifying and treating malnourished children, with 341 cases in 2016 and 302 in 2017, improving only 39 children's health. Officials failed to effectively implement government welfare schemes for women and children, leaving beneficiaries unreached. A nutrition treatment centre opened at Kollegal hospital to serve rural poor from Chamarajanagar and surrounding districts, admitting severely malnourished children for 15 days with nutritious food and Rs 100 daily incentive. The district's backwardness, poverty, and official lapses have drawn attention to persistent gaps in child nutrition programs.

modelFactorWhy.factor: Mothers who took iron-folic acid for 180+ days in pregnancy
modelFactorWhy.why: The pages contain no specific data or discussion about iron-folic acid supplementation practices among pregnant mothers in Chamarajanagar district, though maternal health services are part of broader health infrastructure gaps.
modelFactorWhy.mechanism: Adequate iron-folic acid intake during pregnancy prevents maternal anemia and supports fetal growth, reducing risk of low birth weight and subsequent stunting

modelFactorWhy.why: While the pages mention Anganwadis and school listings, they provide no district-specific data about enrollment rates or school attendance among 3-6 year olds in Chamarajanagar that would explain stunting patterns.
modelFactorWhy.mechanism: School enrollment for young children often connects to Anganwadi services providing supplementary nutrition and early childhood development, reducing undernutrition

modelFactorWhy.factor: Household members covered by health insurance
modelFactorWhy.why: One page confirms Ayushman Bharat scheme operates in Chamarajanagar through empaneled facilities like PHC Mangala, but no data exists on actual household insurance coverage rates in the district.
modelFactorWhy.mechanism: Health insurance coverage reduces financial barriers to accessing healthcare services including nutrition counseling, growth monitoring, and treatment of childhood illnesses affecting growth

proof.claim: PHC Mangala in Chamarajanagara is empaneled under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY scheme
